title: Model catalog, schema version 1
description: Written by the update-model-routing skill to ~/.ai/model-catalog.json (staged as model-catalog.next.json until approved). Never stored inside a repo checkout. models[] is in preference order: T1 first, then T2, then T3, and within a tier the preferred model first. Limits a reader may rely on: model name and reach model slug at most 200 characters, family at most 80, at most 500 models, 50 reach entries per model and 20 efforts per reach. A reader must ignore fields it does not know and must reject a different schemaVersion. reach[].command is for people: a reader must never execute it or build an argument list from it, and uses cli, model, effortStyle and efforts instead.

cli.description: Open string. Known values: claude, codex, agent (Cursor CLI), agy (Antigravity), lm (local models).

plan.description: Optional. The account's plan, read from a signal that costs no quota; unknown when the CLI exposes none. Routing ranks a free pool behind a paid, api or unknown one in the same tier.

lockedUntil.description: Optional. Present only while a quota lockout is in force; nothing routes to this CLI until the day after this date.

pinned.description: True when the user pinned this model's tier.

pinReason.description: A reason when pinned is true, otherwise null.

flagship.description: Optional. True for the model its vendor's own docs name as most capable, among those reachable here; at most one per family. The cross-family review that counts goes to a flagship. Absent means false.

routable.description: False for auto-style models whose backend varies, and others the tier cannot describe.

priceIn.description: USD per million input tokens, or null when unknown.

priceOut.description: USD per million output tokens, or null when unknown.

reach.description: Ordered: the first entry is the preferred way to call the model.

model.description: The slug passed to that CLI.
